name: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd.
summary: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. manufactures and sells belts and construction materials in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automobile and motorcycle transmission belts and related products, such as timing belts, variable speed belts, v-ribbed belts, raw edge v-belts, worm wheels, and accessory drive systems; and industrial power transmission belts and related products, including v-belts for general industry and agricultural machinery, timing belts for general industry, RIBSTAR belts, polyurethane belts, FLEXSTAR belts, pulleys, and couplings. It also provides conveyer belts, systems, and related products comprising mamaline, LOGISTAR, and tailormade solutions;…
